names.legendary: The Unit That Froze a Heatwave

lore.common: Hums in the window and drips a little water onto the pavement below.
lore.uncommon: Blows cold air straight at whoever sits in the one comfy chair.
lore.rare: Cools a room so fast that people put jumpers on in the middle of summer.
lore.epic: Was the only cool room in a heatwave, and the whole family slept on its floor.
lore.legendary: Cooled a whole flat so well in a heatwave that the ice lollies stopped melting on the counter.

names.legendary: The Bomb That Fizzed a Rainbow

lore.common: Fizzes and spins in the bath, turning the water a surprising colour.
lore.uncommon: Leaves glitter in the bath that turns up on everyone for a week.
lore.rare: Fizzes so wildly that the bath turns into a colourful bubbling volcano.
lore.epic: Turned the bath bright purple, and the person in it came out purple for the day.
lore.legendary: Fizzed into a rainbow so bright that the family took photos of the bath instead of the garden.

names.legendary: The Bath That Was Never Too Cold

lore.common: Fills slowly with warm water while the bubbles pile up like clouds.
lore.uncommon: Gets too hot at the tap end, so its bather sits at the other.
lore.rare: Is so relaxing that its bather stays in until their fingers wrinkle like raisins.
lore.epic: Overflowed during a long soak, and the ceiling downstairs got a little shower.
lore.legendary: Stayed warm for a three-hour soak, and the bather came out more relaxed than a sleeping cat.

names.legendary: The Blender That Made Every Smoothie

lore.common: Roars like a jet engine for ten seconds and makes a smoothie.
lore.uncommon: Shakes on the counter when it gets something stuck in its blades.
lore.rare: Blends anything so fast that it turns into a whirlpool in seconds.
lore.epic: Launched its lid mid-blend, and the kitchen got a strawberry ceiling.
lore.legendary: Made a smoothie so perfect that a whole family drank fruit happily for the first time.

names.legendary: The Ink That Wrote a Library

lore.common: Sits in a little glass pot with a dark blue swirl inside.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a blue ring on every desk it has ever stood on.
lore.rare: Spreads across a page in a blot so wide that it looks like a map.
lore.epic: Tipped over on a desk, and three pieces of homework turned into one big blue puddle.
lore.legendary: Wrote enough stories for a whole library with just one pot.

names.legendary: The Bath Every Bird Visited

lore.common: Holds a shallow pool of water in the garden for birds to splash in.
lore.uncommon: Gets so splashed by sparrows that it needs refilling twice a day.
lore.rare: Attracts every bird for a mile, so the garden sounds like a busy cafe.
lore.epic: Hosted so many birds at once that the cat watched from the window in amazement.
lore.legendary: Was visited by every type of bird in the county in one morning, and the birdwatchers cried.

names.legendary: The Bucket That Built a Castle

lore.common: Clanks its handle every time it's set down on the floor.
lore.uncommon: Has a small crack that drips water into every shoe.
lore.rare: Carries so much water that its carrier walks like a wobbly crab.
lore.epic: Built a sandcastle so tall that the tide paused just to look at it.
lore.legendary: Carried water for a whole summer of sandcastles, and every one was taller than the last.

names.legendary: The Well That Granted a Wish

lore.common: Echoes back anything said into it, only a little bit slower.
lore.uncommon: Swallows every coin thrown in and never says what it did with them.
lore.rare: Echoes so loudly that one shout comes back as a whole crowd.
lore.epic: Got so many wishes at a village fete that the rope got tired of pulling the bucket up.
lore.legendary: Granted a small wish so exactly that the whole village started dropping in pennies.

names.legendary: The Barrel That Saved Every Plant

lore.common: Sits under the drainpipe catching rain for the garden.
lore.uncommon: Gets a layer of leaves on top that turns the water slightly brown.
lore.rare: Fills up so fast in a storm that it overflows down the garden path.
lore.epic: Overflowed in a storm and turned the garden into a little pond for a day.
lore.legendary: Kept a whole garden green through the driest summer anyone remembered.

names.legendary: The Can That Saved Every Rainy Day

lore.common: Sits in the cupboard waiting for a cold day and a slice of toast.
lore.uncommon: Has a ring pull that always snaps off halfway round.
lore.rare: Warms up so quickly that lunch is ready before the bread is buttered.
lore.epic: Fed a whole family after a power cut, warmed up on the camping stove.
lore.legendary: Has rescued so many rainy days that the whole cupboard calls it a hero.

names.legendary: The Tank That Never Ran Dry

lore.common: Gurgles in the loft every time someone runs a tap downstairs.
lore.uncommon: Groans at night like a ghost when the pipes are filling.
lore.rare: Refills so loudly that people wake up thinking it is raining.
lore.epic: Groaned so loudly at night that the whole family went up to the loft with a torch.
lore.legendary: Kept a whole house in water through a long dry summer without running out once.

names.legendary: The Cup That Woke Up an Office

lore.common: Steams in the morning and leaves a ring on every desk it sits on.
lore.uncommon: Goes cold while its owner answers one quick email.
lore.rare: Smells so good that everyone in the room wants one too.
lore.epic: Was left on a desk so long that it grew a skin and a small fan club.
lore.legendary: Kept a whole office awake through the longest meeting in history.

names.legendary: The Machine That Made a Million Cups

lore.common: Gurgles and hisses every morning while a queue forms in front of it.
lore.uncommon: Runs out of beans just as the busiest person reaches the front.
lore.rare: Makes coffee so strong that the spoon stands up on its own.
lore.epic: Broke down one Monday, and the whole office was asleep by eleven.
lore.legendary: Made a million cups of coffee and never once spilled one.

names.legendary: The Board That Ironed a Thousand Shirts

lore.common: Unfolds with a creak and a clatter, and stands on three wobbly legs.
lore.uncommon: Snaps its legs shut when somebody is halfway through a shirt.
lore.rare: Collapses whenever it's set up at the wrong height.
lore.epic: Collapsed with a pile of clean shirts on it, and they all needed ironing again.
lore.legendary: Ironed a thousand shirts for a school concert without ever losing a crease.

names.legendary: The Dishwasher That Cleaned Every Party

lore.common: Hums and sloshes after dinner, cleaning plates that somebody rinsed anyway.
lore.uncommon: Puts one fork through to the end of a cycle completely dirty.
lore.rare: Fills the kitchen with a cloud of steam when it's opened too soon.
lore.epic: Was opened mid-cycle, and the steam fogged the whole kitchen like a sauna.
lore.legendary: Cleaned every plate after the biggest party of the year in a single wash.

names.legendary: The Fan That Cooled a Summer

lore.common: Turns its head slowly from side to side, giving everyone a turn of breeze.
lore.uncommon: Blows papers off the desk whenever it gets to the left side.
lore.rare: Blows so strongly that hair stands up straight in front of it.
lore.epic: Blew every piece of homework out of the window on a hot day, and the neighbours brought it back.
lore.legendary: Cooled a whole summer of hot nights and never once got tired of spinning.

names.legendary: The Hydrant That Saved the Street

lore.common: Stands on the pavement looking short and important, with a cap on its head.
lore.uncommon: Is visited by every dog on the street, every single day.
lore.rare: Sprays water so far that firefighters look like they are holding a rainbow.
lore.epic: Was opened by firefighters on a hot day, and every child on the street got soaked.
lore.legendary: Helped firefighters save a whole street, and the street gave it a fresh coat of paint.

names.legendary: The Glass That Clinked a Thousand Toasts

lore.common: Has a tall thin stem and holds sparkling drinks for special occasions.
lore.uncommon: Gets knocked over by every elbow at every party.
lore.rare: Clinks so brightly that every guest in the room stops to listen.
lore.epic: Clinked so many times at a wedding that the cake started to wobble.
lore.legendary: Was raised in a thousand toasts and never lost a single bubble.

names.legendary: The Shaker That Mixed Every Party

lore.common: Rattles with ice and fruit juice, making the whole kitchen clatter.
lore.uncommon: Leaks a little juice from its lid whenever it's shaken too hard.
lore.rare: Shakes drinks so frothy that they come out as fluffy as clouds.
lore.epic: Shook a milkshake so wildly at a party that the lid flew off and painted the ceiling.
lore.legendary: Mixed a fruit drink so delicious that a whole party asked for the recipe.

names.legendary: The Glass That Never Got Smudged

lore.common: Holds water and the fingerprints of whoever drank from it last.
lore.uncommon: Gets put on the counter right where someone will knock it over.
lore.rare: Makes a ringing sound when a wet finger is run round its rim.
lore.epic: Was rung round its rim at dinner until the whole table joined in a song.
lore.legendary: Stayed so perfectly clear that people kept forgetting it was there.

names.legendary: The Spit That Turned All Day

lore.common: Turns a chicken round and round so slowly that everyone watches it.
lore.uncommon: Drips juices into its tray, which smells delicious and looks dreadful.
lore.rare: Turns so hypnotically that people stand in the shop window just watching.
lore.epic: Turned a roast so slowly at a fair that a crowd gathered and missed the parade.
lore.legendary: Turned a whole day without stopping, and every chicken came out perfect.

names.legendary: The Iron That Never Left a Crease

lore.common: Hisses steam whenever it's set down, as if it's had enough.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a shiny patch on trousers when it gets too hot.
lore.rare: Presses clothes so flat that they could be posted under a door.
lore.epic: Steamed a whole pile of shirts before school, and the kitchen became a cloud.
lore.legendary: Ironed every shirt for a whole wedding party without leaving a single crease.

names.legendary: The Rack That Held Every Towel

lore.common: Holds towels until somebody throws theirs on the floor instead.
lore.uncommon: Holds so many towels at once that none of them ever get dry.
lore.rare: Fills up so quickly that the towels pile on top like a soft mountain.
lore.epic: Collapsed under every towel after a beach holiday, and the bathroom looked like a laundry.
lore.legendary: Held every towel for a family of six without ever dropping one.

names.legendary: The Mug That Brewed Itself

lore.common: Holds a cup of tea and a ring stain from every one before it.
lore.uncommon: Gets chipped on the handle but is still everyone's favourite.
lore.rare: Makes tea taste better just by being held, which nobody can explain properly.
lore.epic: Did the office tea round for twenty people, and everyone got exactly how they liked it.
lore.legendary: Has been refilled so many times that it now holds tea on its own.

names.legendary: The Noodles That Never Ended

lore.common: Slurps loudly into mouths and splashes broth on every shirt.
lore.uncommon: Gets wrapped round the fork in a big messy knot.
lore.rare: Is so long that one noodle can be slurped for a whole minute.
lore.epic: Splashed broth on everyone at a noodle bar, and they all laughed and kept slurping.
lore.legendary: Was one single noodle so long that the whole family shared it at once.

names.legendary: The Oven That Baked Every Birthday

lore.common: Glows inside while the cake rises and everyone peeks through the door.
lore.uncommon: Is always hotter at the back, so one side of everything is crispy.
lore.rare: Makes the whole kitchen so hot that the windows fog up.
lore.epic: Baked so many dishes at once on a holiday that the oven door had to be held shut.
lore.legendary: Baked a loaf so tall that it pushed the oven door open and peeked out to say hello.

names.legendary: The Jug That Cooled a Heatwave

lore.common: Holds cold lemonade with ice cubes clinking against its side.
lore.uncommon: Drips down its spout every time it's put back on the table.
lore.rare: Pours so much at once that glasses overflow before anyone can stop it.
lore.epic: Overflowed every glass at a picnic, and the ants had a lemonade party.
lore.legendary: Was refilled so many times on a hot day that it kept a whole party cool.

names.legendary: The Dish That Never Let Go

lore.common: Holds the soap until someone reaches for it with a wet hand.
lore.uncommon: Fills up with a little puddle of soapy water that turns the soap soft.
lore.rare: Lets soap slide off so fast that it shoots across the bathroom floor.
lore.epic: Shot a soap bar across the bath, and the whole family went looking for it.
lore.legendary: Held onto a bar of soap for a whole year without it ever slipping off once.

names.legendary: The Radiator That Dried Every Sock

lore.common: Gurgles and clanks when the heating comes on in the morning.
lore.uncommon: Is always hot at the top and cold at the bottom.
lore.rare: Dries socks so quickly that they become as crunchy as crisps.
lore.epic: Clanked so loudly on a cold morning that the family thought somebody was knocking.
lore.legendary: Has dried so many socks that every single one in the house is warm on cold mornings.

names.legendary: The Duck That Sailed the Seven Baths

lore.common: Bobs on the bath water and squeaks when squeezed.
lore.uncommon: Always floats to the end of the bath away from the child.
lore.rare: Squeaks so loudly that the whole house hears bath time.
lore.epic: Was squeezed so much in one bath that it squeaked a little tune.
lore.legendary: Sailed across so many baths that it has been on more adventures than a pirate.

names.legendary: The Sink That Was Never Empty

lore.common: Drips its tap once every few seconds, all night long.
lore.uncommon: Fills up with washing up whenever anyone turns their back.
lore.rare: Fills with dishes so fast that they pile up taller than the tap.
lore.epic: Overflowed with bubbles during washing up, and the whole kitchen became a foam party.
lore.legendary: Washed every plate after a hundred family dinners and still has a tiny shine.

names.legendary: The Pot That Served a Royal Tea

lore.common: Pours tea in a long curve from its spout, mostly into the cup.
lore.uncommon: Has a lid that rattles whenever the kettle boils, as if it is cheering it on.
lore.rare: Brews so much tea at once that it fills every cup in the room.
lore.epic: Served a whole tea party for twenty people and still had enough left for the cat's saucer of milk.
lore.legendary: Served tea so perfectly at a grand party that the guests wrote a poem about it.

names.legendary: The Machine That Gave Two Snacks

lore.common: Hums in the hallway with its lights on and its snacks in neat rows.
lore.uncommon: Rejects the same coin five times in a row and then takes it without a fuss.
lore.rare: Swallows coins and gives nothing back but a cheerful beep.
lore.epic: Got so many crisps stuck at once that a queue of students waited for one to drop.
lore.legendary: Once gave out two snacks for the price of one, and everyone in school still talks about it.

names.legendary: The Iron That Made Perfect Waffles

lore.common: Clamps shut on batter and makes a grid of little squares.
lore.uncommon: Oozes batter out of its sides whenever it is overfilled.
lore.rare: Makes waffles so crispy that they shatter when they're bitten.
lore.epic: Made waffles for a whole birthday breakfast, and the syrup ran out first.
lore.legendary: Made a waffle so perfect that it was photographed and put on the fridge.

names.legendary: The Cooler That Heard Every Story

lore.common: Glugs a big bubble up its bottle every time a cup is filled.
lore.uncommon: Gathers a little crowd round it every afternoon.
lore.rare: Hears every story in the office, and keeps them all quiet.
lore.epic: Burped such a big bubble that everyone in the office jumped.
lore.legendary: Has heard every story in an office for thirty years and never told a single one.

names.legendary: The Can That Grew a Garden

lore.common: Showers plants gently with its rose and drips on its owner's feet.
lore.uncommon: Is too heavy to lift when full, so it gets filled only halfway.
lore.rare: Pours so gently that the flowers seem to stand up straighter.
lore.epic: Watered a whole garden in a heatwave, and the flowers bloomed overnight.
lore.legendary: Watered a garden so lovingly that it won first prize at the village show.

names.legendary: The Purifier That Cleared the Air

lore.common: Hums quietly in the corner, cleaning air nobody can see.
lore.uncommon: Lights up red whenever someone makes toast too dark.
lore.rare: Cleans the air so well that the house smells like a mountain top.
lore.epic: Cleared the house after a burnt dinner, and the smoke alarm stopped sulking.
lore.legendary: Cleaned the air so well that a sneezy family went a whole spring without a sneeze.

names.legendary: The Tap That Was Always Just Right

lore.common: Has one tap for hot and one for cold, and neither is ever quite right.
lore.uncommon: Drips at night with a little plip that keeps everyone awake.
lore.rare: Goes from cold to boiling in a second, so the bather has to dance.
lore.epic: Was turned on so far that the bath filled in seconds and the bubbles reached the ceiling.
lore.legendary: Ran a bath that was exactly the right temperature, which no tap had ever managed before.

names.legendary: The Tin That Fed a Hungry House

lore.common: Comes in a tin with orange sauce and ends up on a slice of toast.
lore.uncommon: Gets splashed on shirts whenever it's stirred too fast.
lore.rare: Makes a plain piece of toast into the best dinner of the week.
lore.epic: Fed a whole family on a busy evening, and nobody complained about anything.
lore.legendary: Fed a hungry house on a snowy night when the shops were shut, and became a family legend.

names.legendary: The Mug With a Lid and a Story

lore.common: Is a huge mug with a little metal lid that flips up and down.
lore.uncommon: Snaps its lid shut on the nose of whoever drinks from it.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who lifts it want to sing a loud song.
lore.epic: Was clinked at a festival so hard that the lids all popped up together.
lore.legendary: Has a story painted round its side, and every visitor adds a new chapter.

names.legendary: The Bowl Nobody Knew How to Use

lore.common: Sits next to the toilet in holiday flats and confuses every visitor.
lore.uncommon: Gets used as a foot bath by every child who finds it.
lore.rare: Sprays water so unexpectedly that whoever turns it on gets a surprise.
lore.epic: Sprayed a whole holiday family in turn, and they all came out laughing.
lore.legendary: Was used for so many things on one holiday that it was a sink, a foot bath and a fish pond.

names.legendary: The Cup That Was Only for Visitors

lore.common: Is so thin that light shines through it when it's held up.
lore.uncommon: Clinks on its saucer every time it's lifted.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who drinks from it hold their little finger out.
lore.epic: Was used at a garden party so carefully that nobody dared to drink.
lore.legendary: Was kept safe for fifty years and finally used on the perfect day.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Held Everything

lore.common: Has rice, beans and a little bit of everything piled high in it.
lore.uncommon: Gets so full that the first forkful sends half of it over the side.
lore.rare: Is so filling that nobody can eat anything else until supper.
lore.epic: Was piled so high that the lid wouldn't close, and lunch fell on the floor.
lore.legendary: Held a whole meal for four in one bowl, and nobody went home hungry.

names.legendary: The Mug That Climbed a Mountain

lore.common: Is chipped and dented and is always hot on the handle.
lore.uncommon: Clinks on everything in the rucksack and keeps everyone awake.
lore.rare: Keeps tea so warm on a cold morning that the whole campsite is jealous.
lore.epic: Made tea on a mountain top, and the clouds parted for the view.
lore.legendary: Has climbed every mountain in the country on one family's rucksack.

names.legendary: The Cereal That Never Went Soggy

lore.common: Rattles in its box and crunches loudly in the bowl.
lore.uncommon: Goes soggy in exactly the time it takes to find a spoon.
lore.rare: Lures every person in the house downstairs with the rattle of its box before the bowl is even out.
lore.epic: Was poured so fast that it went all over the table, and the dog had breakfast too.
lore.legendary: Stayed crunchy for a whole hour in milk, and the family still can't believe it.

names.legendary: The Rack That Dried a Family

lore.common: Unfolds in the lounge and covers itself in damp socks and pants.
lore.uncommon: Takes up so much room that everyone squeezes past it sideways.
lore.rare: Dries clothes so slowly in winter that they are ready just in time for the next wash.
lore.epic: Was so full of washing that the family had to crawl under it to reach the sofa.
lore.legendary: Dried a whole family's washing for twenty years without ever collapsing.

names.legendary: The Coleslaw Everyone Asked For

lore.common: Crunches in a creamy heap next to every barbecue plate.
lore.uncommon: Gets left in the fridge until it goes a bit sad and watery.
lore.rare: Is so crunchy that people take three spoonfuls before the burgers arrive.
lore.epic: Was eaten so fast at a barbecue that the burgers were left on their own.
lore.legendary: Was asked for at every party for twenty years, and the recipe is still a family secret.

names.legendary: The Jug That Made Perfect Clouds

lore.common: Holds a little milk for the tea and dribbles some down its own side.
lore.uncommon: Pours one drop too many every time, so the tea goes pale.
lore.rare: Swirls milk into coffee so beautifully that nobody wants to stir it.
lore.epic: Poured so many swirls at a cafe that a queue formed just to watch.
lore.legendary: Poured a milk cloud so perfect into a cup that it looked like a tiny sky.

names.legendary: The Curry That Warmed a Winter

lore.common: Bubbles in its bowl with a smell that reaches next door.
lore.uncommon: Is always hotter than the cook said it would be.
lore.rare: Makes eyes water and noses run, and everyone asks for more anyway.
lore.epic: Was so spicy at a Friday curry night that the whole table drank a jug of milk.
lore.legendary: Warmed a whole family through a snowy winter week, and nobody caught a cold.

names.legendary: The Machine That Dried the House

lore.common: Hums in the corner, slowly filling its little tank with water from the air.
lore.uncommon: Beeps when its tank is full, usually at two in the morning.
lore.rare: Dries the air so well that the washing dries indoors in an afternoon.
lore.epic: Pulled so much water from the air in a rainy week that the tank had to be emptied every hour.
lore.legendary: Dried a whole damp house in a week, and the mould packed its bags and left.

names.legendary: The Rack That Held Every Plate

lore.common: Holds wet plates and cups while they drip onto the draining board.
lore.uncommon: Has one slot that is never the right size for the plate.
lore.rare: Piles up so high after a party that it looks like a leaning tower.
lore.epic: Collapsed under a pile of party plates, and the kitchen sounded like a cymbal solo.
lore.legendary: Balanced a whole birthday party's plates in a tower so tall that the cat sat on top like a flag.

names.legendary: The Fountain Every Child Loved

lore.common: Shoots a little arc of water up for anyone thirsty enough to lean in.
lore.uncommon: Shoots water straight up the nose of whoever presses it too hard.
lore.rare: Sprays so unexpectedly that every child gets their shirt soaked.
lore.epic: Soaked a whole class at once on sports day, and they all said it was the best part.
lore.legendary: Has given a drink to every child in the school for fifty years, and they all remember it.

names.legendary: The Cup That Held the Perfect Egg

lore.common: Holds a boiled egg upright and waits for toast soldiers.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles so that the egg rolls out when the top is tapped.
lore.rare: Holds an egg so perfectly that the yolk comes out runny every time.
lore.epic: Was topped so hard at breakfast that the yolk splashed onto the newspaper.
lore.legendary: Held a perfectly boiled egg every morning for twenty years, and never wobbled once.

names.legendary: The Mug That Went Everywhere

lore.common: Is blue with white speckles and has a little chip at the rim.
lore.uncommon: Gets too hot to hold when it's filled with tea straight from the fire.
lore.rare: Makes every drink taste like an adventure.
lore.epic: Was taken on a lake trip, and everyone wanted a sip from it.
lore.legendary: Went on every family holiday for forty years and came back with a new chip each time.

names.legendary: The Cup That Woke a City

lore.common: Comes on its own tiny saucer and looks like a cup made for a doll's tea party.
lore.uncommon: Gets drunk in one sip before anyone can even put it down.
lore.rare: Holds coffee so strong that a single sip wakes up the whole body.
lore.epic: Was drunk in one sip before a train, and its owner ran faster than ever.
lore.legendary: Has woken up so many people that the city's morning starts with its clink.

names.legendary: The Spa That Soothed Every Foot

lore.common: Buzzes and bubbles under tired feet after a long day.
lore.uncommon: Splashes water across the floor whenever it's switched on too high.
lore.rare: Makes feet so relaxed that their owner falls asleep in the chair.
lore.epic: Was passed round the whole family after a long walk, and everyone fell asleep.
lore.legendary: Soothed so many tired feet after a marathon that the runners gave it a medal.

names.legendary: The Rice That Fed a Whole Party

lore.common: Has peas, egg and little crispy bits all mixed into its rice.
lore.uncommon: Has one pea that falls off the fork every time.
lore.rare: Is so tasty that the last spoonful causes a family argument.
lore.epic: Was ordered for a party, and every grain was gone before the main dishes.
lore.legendary: Fed a whole party from one wok, and nobody went home hungry.

names.legendary: The Tap That Filled the Pool

lore.common: Sits on the outside wall and drips onto the path.
lore.uncommon: Is always too stiff to turn on and too loose to turn off.
lore.rare: Gushes so hard when opened that the hose leaps out of its owner's hand.
lore.epic: Filled the paddling pool so fast that the children jumped in before it was full.
lore.legendary: Filled every paddling pool on the street in a heatwave, and every child cheered.

names.legendary: The Granola That Lasted Till Lunch

lore.common: Crunches in the bowl in little honey-sweet clusters.
lore.uncommon: Leaves bits stuck in teeth all the way until lunch.
lore.rare: Is so crunchy that the whole kitchen hears every mouthful.
lore.epic: Was made so crunchy that the family went to the dentist for a check-up.
lore.legendary: Kept a whole hiking group full all the way up a mountain and back.

names.legendary: The Boat That Sailed Every Roast

lore.common: Sails round the dinner table full of gravy, dripping from its spout.
lore.uncommon: Dribbles gravy on the tablecloth every time it's passed.
lore.rare: Pours gravy so generously that the potatoes float.
lore.epic: Poured so much gravy at a Sunday lunch that the plates turned into lakes.
lore.legendary: Has sailed round so many Sunday roasts that it has its own seat at the table.

names.legendary: The Humidifier That Made a Cloud

lore.common: Puffs a soft mist into the air of the bedroom.
lore.uncommon: Fogs up the windows so that nobody can see out in the morning.
lore.rare: Makes the room so misty that it looks like a forest in the morning.
lore.epic: Was left on all night, and the room woke up looking like a rainforest.
lore.legendary: Made a little cloud in the bedroom that floated above the bed all night.

names.legendary: The Glass That Held Every Sunrise

lore.common: Holds orange juice at breakfast and leaves a little ring on the table.
lore.uncommon: Gets knocked over by the cereal box nearly every morning.
lore.rare: Makes juice look so bright that the sun comes out to have a look.
lore.epic: Was knocked over at breakfast, and the juice ran across the table and under the cat.
lore.legendary: Held a glass of juice every morning for so many years that it looks like a tiny sunrise.

names.legendary: The Lasagne That Fed a Street

lore.common: Has layers of pasta, sauce and cheese that slide apart when it's cut.
lore.uncommon: Is too hot to eat for at least twenty minutes after it comes out.
lore.rare: Is so cheesy that every slice stretches like elastic.
lore.epic: Was cut at a party and stretched so far that the cheese reached the next table.
lore.legendary: Fed a whole street at a party, and the last slice was fought over at midnight.

names.legendary: The Loofah That Scrubbed Every Back

lore.common: Is scratchy and spongy and hangs on a string in the shower.
lore.uncommon: Takes days to dry and never quite stops dripping.
lore.rare: Scrubs so well that its user comes out glowing pink.
lore.epic: Scrubbed a muddy footballer so well that he came out looking brand new.
lore.legendary: Scrubbed every back in a family of six for ten years and never fell apart.

names.legendary: The Bowl Everyone Wanted Seconds Of

lore.common: Is cheesy and creamy, and its crust gets fought over.
lore.uncommon: Gets cold so fast that the cheese turns solid.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who eats it go quiet with happiness.
lore.epic: Was made so cheesy at a sleepover that the pasta was lost under the cheese.
lore.legendary: Was asked for seconds at every family dinner for twenty years.

names.legendary: The Glass That Toasted a Gala

lore.common: Has a wide pointy bowl that tips over at the slightest wobble.
lore.uncommon: Is so wide that half its drink spills before it reaches the table.
lore.rare: Makes anyone holding it stand up straight and look very fancy.
lore.epic: Was clinked at a fancy dinner so hard that its little olive jumped out.
lore.legendary: Was raised at a grand gala and held its fruit juice so elegantly that the whole room clapped.

names.legendary: The Jug That Measured Everything

lore.common: Has lines up its side for millilitres, cups and pints.
lore.uncommon: Gets used for juice once and for gravy the next day.
lore.rare: Measures liquids so exactly that every recipe comes out perfect.
lore.epic: Measured all the milk for pancake day, and every pancake was the same size.
lore.legendary: Measured the rain in the garden so carefully one summer that the weather forecaster rang to ask for its numbers.

names.legendary: The Glass That Grew Strong Bones

lore.common: Leaves a white moustache on everyone who drinks from it.
lore.uncommon: Gets left on the bedside table and goes a bit sour by the morning.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who drinks a whole glass feel strong enough to carry the shopping in one trip.
lore.epic: Gave the whole family milk moustaches at breakfast, and they took a group photo.
lore.legendary: Was drunk from every night for so many years that its owner grew taller than their dad.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Warmed Every Winter

lore.common: Is warm and gloopy and is always eaten with a heap of honey.
lore.uncommon: Sticks to the pan so hard that it needs soaking all day.
lore.rare: Fills its eater so well that they skip their mid-morning snack.
lore.epic: Was made so thick on a cold morning that the spoon stood up on its own.
lore.legendary: Was stirred so slowly and so well that a grandad said it tasted exactly like the one his gran made.

names.legendary: The Paella That Fed a Village

lore.common: Is golden yellow with peas, peppers and a crispy bottom.
lore.uncommon: Has one prawn on top that everyone pretends not to want.
lore.rare: Has a crispy bottom so delicious that people scrape the pan.
lore.epic: Was shared out so slowly that the prawn on top got passed round the table four times and still nobody took it.
lore.legendary: Was so good at a family reunion that three cousins who had argued for years sat down and shared the crispy bit.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Cured Every Cold

lore.common: Steams with broth, noodles and a pile of fresh herbs on top.
lore.uncommon: Splashes broth on the shirt with every slurp.
lore.rare: Smells so good that people in the street stop to sniff.
lore.epic: Was slurped so loudly at a lunch that the whole restaurant joined in.
lore.legendary: Warmed so many people on cold days that it became the town's favourite remedy for a sniffle.

names.legendary: The Plunger That Saved the Day

lore.common: Stands by the toilet waiting for an emergency, which it secretly enjoys.
lore.uncommon: Makes a loud schlurp sound whenever it's pulled up.
lore.rare: Unblocks any drain with one push, which is a relief to everyone.
lore.epic: Saved a family party when the bathroom flooded, and everyone cheered.
lore.legendary: Has saved so many bathrooms that the plumber sends it thank-you cards.

names.legendary: The Porridge That Was Just Right

lore.common: Bubbles in the pan and sticks to the bottom if left for a moment.
lore.uncommon: Is always either too hot or too cold, never quite right.
lore.rare: Is so filling that its eater doesn't need lunch.
lore.epic: Was made so thick that the spoon stood up and the bowl turned over in one piece.
lore.legendary: Was finally just right, not too hot and not too cold, and the whole family cheered.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Was Slurped Clean

lore.common: Has noodles, broth and a perfectly cooked egg floating on top.
lore.uncommon: Gets splashed broth across the table from every slurp.
lore.rare: Is so tasty that every noodle is slurped loudly.
lore.epic: Was slurped so loudly at a late night meal that the neighbours came to see.
lore.legendary: Was slurped clean so many times that it shines like a mirror.

names.legendary: The Hood That Cleared Every Smoke

lore.common: Hums over the cooker and sucks up steam and smells.
lore.uncommon: Drips a little grease onto the cooker if its filter isn't cleaned.
lore.rare: Sucks up steam so strongly that the kitchen never fogs.
lore.epic: Cleared a burnt toast smell so fast that the smoke alarm didn't notice.
lore.legendary: Has cleared every cooking smell for twenty years, and the kitchen smells like nothing at all.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Outlasted the Cooker

lore.common: Holds a little mound of fluffy white rice at every meal.
lore.uncommon: Gets a grain of rice stuck to its rim that nobody notices.
lore.rare: Is refilled so often that the rice cooker can barely keep up.
lore.epic: Held so much rice at a dinner that it toppled over like a snowy mountain.
lore.legendary: Was refilled at every meal for twenty years and was never seen empty.

names.legendary: The Risotto That Stirred a City

lore.common: Needs stirring every minute, so the cook can never leave the pan.
lore.uncommon: Takes forty minutes to make and three minutes to eat.
lore.rare: Is so creamy that people close their eyes when they take a bite.
lore.epic: Was stirred so long at a dinner party that the guests fell asleep before it was ready.
lore.legendary: Was so creamy and delicious that a whole city queued at the restaurant to try it.

names.legendary: The Table That Stitched a Wardrobe

lore.common: Hums and whirrs as the needle goes up and down at speed.
lore.uncommon: Tangles its thread underneath whenever someone is in a hurry.
lore.rare: Stitches so fast that the fabric runs out before the thread does.
lore.epic: Stitched a whole school play's costumes in a single night, and everyone was dressed by dawn.
lore.legendary: Has stitched so many outfits that the whole town has worn something it made.

names.legendary: The Table With a Thousand Buttons

lore.common: Is covered in pins, fabric scraps and a tape measure that won't roll up.
lore.uncommon: Has a drawer full of buttons that spills whenever it's opened.
lore.rare: Hides needles in its fabric so cleverly that they turn up in the sofa.
lore.epic: Spilled a whole tin of buttons, and the family found them for a month.
lore.legendary: Has a thousand buttons in its drawers, and no two of them match.

names.legendary: The Glass That Measured Medicine

lore.common: Is a tiny heavy glass with a thick bottom that clinks on the table.
lore.uncommon: Gets used to measure cough syrup and spills a little every time.
lore.rare: Holds such a small amount that nobody is sure what it is for.
lore.epic: Was used as a tiny vase for a daisy, and the whole table admired it.
lore.legendary: Was used to measure medicine for a whole family through a long winter of colds.

names.legendary: The Shower That Sang Every Morning

lore.common: Starts cold for ten seconds before deciding to be warm.
lore.uncommon: Changes temperature whenever someone flushes the toilet.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who stands under it sing loudly and badly.
lore.epic: Went cold in the middle of a hair wash, and the shriek woke the neighbours.
lore.legendary: Has heard so many songs sung inside it that it can hum along to all of them.

names.legendary: The Head That Rained Every Morning

lore.common: Sprays water in a dozen little jets, two of which go sideways.
lore.uncommon: Gets blocked by limescale until it only works on one side.
lore.rare: Sprays so hard that its user is pushed against the wall.
lore.epic: Was turned to full power and blasted the shampoo bottle off the shelf.
lore.legendary: Has rained on so many mornings that the plants in the bathroom think it is a cloud.

names.legendary: The Mug That Warmed a Rainy Day

lore.common: Holds soup instead of tea, which confuses visitors.
lore.uncommon: Gets too hot to hold, so its owner wraps it in their sleeve.
lore.rare: Keeps soup so warm that it's still steaming after a long phone call.
lore.epic: Warmed a whole family after a rainy walk, and nobody caught a cold.
lore.legendary: Has warmed so many rainy days that the sun comes out a little whenever it's filled.

names.legendary: The Sponge That Washed a Mountain

lore.common: Squishes and soaks and gets smaller every week.
lore.uncommon: Starts to smell a bit funny if it is not left out to dry.
lore.rare: Soaks up so much water that it drips all the way across the kitchen.
lore.epic: Washed every dish after a party, and was given a rest on the windowsill.
lore.legendary: Washed a mountain of dishes so big that it was given a medal and retired.

names.legendary: The Bowl That Sweetened a Party

lore.common: Holds sugar lumps and a pair of tiny tongs that nobody can use properly.
lore.uncommon: Gets a wet spoon dipped into it, so the sugar turns into rocks.
lore.rare: Lets sugar spill whenever its lid is lifted.
lore.epic: Lost every sugar lump to a sneaky toddler at a tea party, and nobody's tea was sweet that day.
lore.legendary: Sweetened a hundred cups of tea at a garden party and still had sugar left.

names.legendary: The Tankard With a Glass Bottom

lore.common: Is heavy and made of pewter, with a handle big enough for a whole fist.
lore.uncommon: Clanks on the table so loudly that everyone looks up.
lore.rare: Is so heavy that lifting it once is a workout.
lore.epic: Was clinked so hard at a harvest fair that it dented the table.
lore.legendary: Has a glass bottom so its owner can see who's coming while drinking their apple juice.

names.legendary: The Cup That Never Spilled a Drop

lore.common: Clinks on its saucer every time it's lifted for a sip.
lore.uncommon: Spills a little tea into the saucer whenever it's carried.
lore.rare: Makes anyone drinking from it hold their little finger in the air.
lore.epic: Was rattled on its saucer so much at a tea party that the cake wobbled.
lore.legendary: Was carried across a crowded room by a waiter and didn't spill a single drop.

names.legendary: The Set That Hosted Every Party

lore.common: Has a teapot, cups and saucers that all match, except one.
lore.uncommon: Has one cup with a chip that always goes to the visitor.
lore.rare: Makes any afternoon feel like a party just by being set out.
lore.epic: Hosted a garden tea party so grand that the neighbours put on their best hats.
lore.legendary: Has hosted every family party for fifty years without losing a single cup.

names.legendary: The Brush That Kept It Sparkling

lore.common: Waits in its pot beside the toilet, doing its job with no complaints.
lore.uncommon: Drips onto the floor whenever it's put back too quickly.
lore.rare: Scrubs so well that the toilet sparkles like a mirror.
lore.epic: Scrubbed a whole bathroom before a party, and the guests complimented the toilet.
lore.legendary: Has kept a bathroom so sparkling for twenty years that it's the cleanest in the town.

names.legendary: The Cup That Never Spilled on a Bus

lore.common: Keeps coffee warm on the way to work and spills a bit at every bump.
lore.uncommon: Has a lid that never quite clicks shut.
lore.rare: Keeps tea so warm that it's still too hot to drink by the time work starts.
lore.epic: Was dropped on the platform and bounced back up without spilling a drop.
lore.legendary: Went on a thousand bus journeys without spilling once, which nobody believes.

names.legendary: The Fountain That Danced in the Park

lore.common: Splashes water in the park with a little arc that sparkles in the sun.
lore.uncommon: Sprays water onto everyone who walks past on a windy day.
lore.rare: Sprays so high that rainbows form in the sun.
lore.epic: Splashed a whole park on a windy day, and everyone ran through it laughing.
lore.legendary: Danced its water in the park for a hundred years, and every child made a wish in it.

names.legendary: The Pump That Watered a Village

lore.common: Squeaks loudly whenever its handle is pumped up and down.
lore.uncommon: Takes ten pumps before any water comes out.
lore.rare: Pumps water so cold that it makes teeth ache.
lore.epic: Was pumped by every child at a village fair, and the square became a puddle.
lore.legendary: Has watered a whole village for two hundred years without ever running dry.

names.legendary: The Glass That Never Tipped Over

lore.common: Has no stem, so it sits low and round on the picnic blanket.
lore.uncommon: Gets fingerprints all over it from being held round its middle.
lore.rare: Is so round that it rolls across the table when it's knocked.
lore.epic: Rolled across a picnic and landed perfectly upright in the grass.
lore.legendary: Was knocked over a hundred times at picnics and never spilled its juice once.
